wordProblems.q: Mason buys 6 packs with 8 stickers in each pack, then shares all the stickers equally with 5 friends, so 6 children share them. How many stickers does each child get?
A garden is 9 metres long and 9 metres wide. How many square metres is the garden?
Lily earns $12 each week for 4 weeks. Lily buys a ball for $20. How many dollars does Lily have left?
Amelia puts 84 marbles into bags of 12 marbles each. Amelia finds 9 more marbles. How many marbles does Amelia have in all?
Each bus holds 42 children. 2 buses are full, and 11 more children walk. How many children are going on the trip?
A recipe needs 7 eggs for one cake. A baker makes 4 cakes and uses 20 eggs for something else from the same box. How many eggs does the baker use in all?
Each pizza has 9 slices. There are 4 pizzas. The family eats 17 slices. How many slices are left?
Noah buys 3 books for $9 each and 4 pens for $3 each. How many dollars does Noah spend in all?
Lucas practises piano for 4 hours and then for 29 more minutes. How many minutes did Lucas practise in all?
A theatre has 10 rows with 10 seats in each row. 77 seats are taken. How many seats are empty?
A teacher has 6 packs with 5 crayons in each pack. She shares all the crayons equally among 3 tables. How many crayons does each table get?
Ruby gets $4 pocket money every day for 7 days. Ruby spends $15 on a toy. How many dollars does Ruby have left?
A cyclist rides 37 kilometres each day for 4 days. After 73 kilometres, how many kilometres are left to ride?
A garden is 12 metres long and 10 metres wide. How many metres of fence are needed to go all the way around it?
A shop buys toy cars for $8 each and sells them for $13 each. How many dollars of profit does the shop make on 5 toy cars?
Owen plans to read 14 pages every day for 5 days. Owen has already read 24 pages. How many pages are left to read?
There are 8 teams with 5 players in each team. How many players are there in all?
A baker makes 4 trays with 6 cookies on each tray. She shares all the cookies equally among 3 classes. How many cookies does each class get?
Amelia has 77 sweets. Amelia shares them equally with 6 friends, so 7 children share them. How many sweets does each child get?
A shop packs 35 eggs into boxes of 5 eggs. How many boxes does the shop fill?
A runner runs 22 kilometres each day for 3 days. After running 54 kilometres, how many kilometres are left to run?
A child buys cups of lemonade for $3 each and sells them for $6 each. How much profit does the child make on 5 cups?
A baker makes 4 trays with 6 scones on each tray. She shares all the scones equally among 6 friends. How many scones does each friend get?
Sara practises violin for 1 hour and 17 minutes on Saturday and for 1 hour and 29 minutes on Sunday. How many minutes did Sara practise in all?
Zoe earns $11 each week for 6 weeks and then spends $54 on a board game. How many dollars does Zoe have left?
A classroom library has 5 shelves with 9 books on each shelf. The teacher lends 28 books to another class. How many books are left in the library?
Isabella and 5 friends earn $66 washing cars together. They share the money equally. How many dollars does each child get?
A teacher buys 3 packs with 7 pencils in each pack. She shares all the pencils equally among 3 classes. How many pencils does each class get?
Ben watches a film for 53 minutes. Then Ben takes a 17-minute break and watches the film for 30 more minutes. How many minutes does Ben spend watching the film in all?
A rug is 9 metres long and 4 metres wide. How many square metres is the rug?
